notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only Umbra's non-region, receive-order Update Attribute Values and no-time Reflect Attribute Values path in the non-installable development profile. It uses only candidate records exported by the Requirements Lab and does not infer missing IDs. The recipient planner selects active ordinary attribute subscriptions only; passive subscriptions remain retained declaration state but cannot arrange a reflected update. The standard-wide passive-subscription delivery definition is source-level evidence on page 30 rather than an immutable requirement-candidate, so the delivery predicate is paired with the available Clause 5.8 active/passive state record (RL-029). The three page-112 passelization records are exported with clause_id clause-6.1.13 even though the IEEE source heading is §6.1.12; RL-013 records that reproducible export mismatch, and this contract intentionally uses the exported owner. Timestamped/retraction behavior, DDM regions, update-rate reduction, ownership acquisition/divestiture, custom transportation implementation, FOM sharing policy, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, and evidence promotion remain out of scope. The linked Catch2 test demonstrates a bounded implementation slice, not full IEEE 1516.1-2025 conformance.
